mentions.name: ata
mentions.description: An open source research and coding agent that helps combine and understand concepts across multiple papers, pull the best ideas from each, and turn them into code. It uses Treesitter and LSP for multi-repo code understanding, with a focused reading view, a voice mode with karaoke-style word highlighting, and an upcoming iOS app for research on the go. Installable via npm as @a2a-ai/ata.
